column1: 21960§remarkable§rɪˈmɑːkəbl§More than 4,000 species of these remarkable creatures have evolved and adapted to the world's different climates.§这些**极不平常**的生物中已有4,000多种进化并适应了地球上不同的气候。§
21961§clot§klɒt§Doctors gave the patient a drug to dissolve the blood clot that had formed in his leg.§医生给病人用了一种药，来溶解他腿部形成的血**凝块**。§补例句
21962§prior§ˈpraɪə(r)§This degree course needs no prior qualifications.§这种学位课程不需要**先决**条件。§
21963§integrate§ˈɪntɪgreɪt§The researchers don't know how to integrate the two actions.§研究者不知该如何将这两种行为**融为一体**。§
21964§exemplify§ɪgˈzemplɪfaɪ§Robin Hill Park exemplifies the standards in natural zoos.§罗宾山郊野公园是自然动物园的**典范**。§
21965§formulation§ˌfɔːmjuˈleɪʃn§Could you choose another formulation?§你能选择另一种**表达方式**吗？§
21966§exploratory§ɪkˈsplɒrətri§The patient is having some exploratory tests done to find out what's causing the illness.§病人正在接受**探查性**检查，以找到致病原因。§改译文：原译文没译出 exploratory，加「探查性」
21967§pasture§ˈpɑːstʃə(r)§More than 1,000 acre fields were planted with crops several years ago, but now are returned to pasture for the cattle.§数年前，这里是一千多英亩的农田，如今退耕还牧，成为**牧场**。§
21968§nutrient§ˈnjuːtriənt§Embryos absorb mineral and other nutrients from their mothers.§胎儿从母体中吸收矿物质和其他**营养物质**。§
21969§plough§plaʊ§The farmer abandoned his plough and waited by the tree stump, hoping to get another hare.§那个农民荒废了**耕作**，在树桩旁等着，希望能再得到一只兔子。§
21970§patriotic§ˌpætriˈɒtɪk§Teenagers felt it's patriotic to serve in the army to maintain world peace.§年轻人认为，为维护世界和平而服兵役是**爱国**的表现。§
21971§scrub§skrʌb§When the cleaner scrubbed the building interior, it had a brand-new look.§当清洁工把建筑内部**擦洗**干净后，整个建筑焕然一新。§改例句：前后时态不一致，has 改 had

21972§formality§fɔːˈmæləti§Juventus are not underestimating anyone and if there is someone who considers this match a pure formality, then they do not belong to this team.§尤文图斯队不会低估任何一个对手，如果哪个队员认为这场比赛只是个**形式**，他就不属于这支球队。§

21973§perquisite§ˈpɜːkwɪzɪt§Fringe benefits, perquisites and perks are various non-wage compensations provided to employees in addition to their normal wages or salaries.§额外福利、**补贴**和津贴是除了正常工资之外，提供给雇员的几种非工资补偿形式。§
21974§simplicity§sɪmˈplɪsəti§For the sake of simplicity, the teacher might recommend the student to use this reference book.§为**简便**起见，老师可向学生推荐使用这本参考书。§
21975§heighten§ˈhaɪtn§You can heighten the degree of your wisdom with the help of your rivals.§在对手的帮助下，你能够**提高**自己的智慧。§改译文：原译「变得更聪明」括不出 heighten（提高），改译
21976§assimilation§əˌsɪməˈleɪʃn§Language assimilation is the progressive process whereby a speech community of a language shifts to speaking another language.§语言**同化**是指讲话群体由一种语言转向另一种语言的渐进过程。§
21977§necessity§nəˈsesəti§Out of necessity or out of interest, people return to school for the common goal of self-improvement.§不管是出于**需要**还是兴趣，人们重返学校都是为了一个共同的目标——提高自己。§

21978§disposable§dɪˈspəʊzəbl§In the domestic market, people are increasing their disposable income, which provides China a huge potential market.§在国内市场，民众的**可支配**收入不断增加，为中国提供了一个巨大的潜在市场。§改例句：domestic market 前缺冠词 the；英文句中的中文逗号改为英文逗号
21979§ingenuity§ˌɪndʒəˈnjuːəti§The little girl showed her ingenuity in making handicrafts out of scraps of paper.§小女孩将纸片做成工艺品，展示出她的**心灵手巧**。§

21980§luxuriant§lʌgˈʒʊəriənt§WWF predicted early this year that the luxuriant Amazon Forest could become a grassy savannah by the end of this century.§世界野生动物基金会今年年初预测，**茂盛**的亚马孙森林将可能在本世纪末变为大草原。§改例句：predicated（断言）用错，应为 predicted（预测）
21981§consequential§ˌkɒnsɪˈkwenʃl§The teacher discusses with his students the consequential matters after the financial crisis.§老师在跟同学们一起讨论金融危机后可能**产生的**一些问题。§改例句：discuss 是及物动词，删去 about
21982§scour§ˈskaʊə(r)§The rainstorm raced down the slope and scoured out the bed of a stream.§暴雨顺着斜坡倾泻而下，**冲刷**着河床。§

21983§seasonal§ˈsiːzənl§Seasonal weather fluctuations depend on factors such as proximity to oceans or other large bodies of water, currents in those oceans, and prevailing winds.§**季节性**的气候变化取决于与海洋或者其他大型水体的临近程度、洋流及季风等因素。§改译文：seasonal 是「季节性」，「周期性」改「季节性」
21984§murky§ˈmɜːki§In early medieval Britain, every castle had a cold murky dungeon for prisoners.§在中世纪早期的英国，每个城堡都有一个冰冷**阴暗**的地牢，用于关押囚犯。§
21985§cue§kjuː§The actor got his cue from the director.§那位男演员从导演那里得到了一些**提示**。§
21986§thermal§ˈθɜːml§A heat pump puts out more thermal energy than it consumes.§热泵产生的**热**能要高于它所消耗的热能。§
21987§revolution§ˌrevəˈluːʃn§Acid rain in fact started around the time of the industrial revolution of the 19th century.§酸雨实际上是在19世纪工业**革命**时期开始出现的。§
21988§romance§rəʊˈmæns§That was nothing but a spicy Hollywood romance.§那简直就是一部粗俗的好莱坞**浪漫故事片**。§
21989§currently§ˈkʌrəntli§Fingerprint scanners are currently the most widely deployed type of biometric application.§指纹扫描是**目前**生物测定技术中发展最为迅速的应用项目。§

21990§inferential§ˌɪnfəˈrenʃəl§For young children, the difficulty lies not in the inferential processes which the task demands, but in certain perplexing features of the apparatus and the procedure.§对于小孩子们来说，难点不在于任务所需的**推理**过程，而在于设备和程序的某些特征令人困惑。§
21991§persist§pəˈsɪst§If you persist in indifference, do not make me your confidante.§如果你**坚持**这么冷漠，就别让我做你的好朋友。§
21992§minimum§ˈmɪnɪməm§The minimum speed on the freeway is 45 km/h.§这条高速公路上的**最低**时速为45公里。§
21993§output§ˈaʊtpʊt§In some countries, subsidies for growing crops and price supports for farm output drive up the price of land.§在某些国家，农作物种植补助金以及针对农业**产量**的价格补贴抬高了地价。§
21994§stash§stæʃ§The bees stash honey to eat later.§蜜蜂将蜂蜜**贮藏**起来供以后食用。§
21995§species§ˈspiːʃiːz§Between 1968 and 1982, the country imported about 50 different species of dung beetle, from Asia, Europe and Africa.§在1968年到1982年间，该国从亚洲、欧洲和非洲进口了大约50种不同**种类**的蜣螂。§
21996§subtle§ˈsʌtl§Many characteristics result from subtle interactions between genes and the environment.§许多特征都是通过基因和环境之间**微妙**的相互作用形成的。§
21997§competent§ˈkɒmpɪtənt§This new manager was really competent.§新任经理的确很**能干**。§
21998§select§sɪˈlekt§More and more employers are making use of what are called "personality questionnaires" to help them select new staff.§越来越多的雇主正在利用所谓的“性格调查问卷”来帮助自己**挑选**新员工。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
21999§loose§luːs§The soil in which coffee is grown must be rich, moist and sufficiently loose to allow rapid drainage.§种植咖啡的土壤必须肥沃、潮湿且土质十分**疏松**以便迅速排水。§
22000§available§əˈveɪləbl§We hope that ostrich meat will be available soon and before long will be as cheap as beef.§我们希望不久就可以**买到**鸵鸟肉，而且希望它的价格不久就会变得和牛肉一样便宜。§
22001§illustration§ˌɪləˈstreɪʃn§There is virtually no empirical evidence to support the use of illustrations in teaching reading.§事实上没有任何经验证据支持在阅读教学过程中使用**插图**。§
22002§slice§slaɪs§I brought you a slice of pizza.§我给你带了**一块**比萨。§
22003§waterfront§ˈwɔːtəfrʌnt§Those countries still maintain their business centres near the port waterfront.§那些国家的商业中心仍然靠近**码头**。§
22004§generic§dʒəˈnerɪk§The generic term for that plant is difficult to remember.§那种植物的**种类**名称很难记。§
22005§cricket§ˈkrɪkɪt§There was precious little about the cricket to animate the crowd.§这场**板球**比赛极少有让观众兴奋的地方。§

22006§exhale§eksˈheɪl§Passive smoking, the breathing in of the side-stream smoke from the burning of tobacco or of the smoke exhaled by a smoker, also causes a serious health risk.§被动吸烟，即从燃烧的烟草中吸入侧流烟或吸烟者**呼出**的烟，也会给健康带来严重威胁。§
22007§creation§kriˈeɪʃn§The very first fire-creation methods involved the use of friction.§最早的**取**火方法都离不开摩擦。§
22008§corporate§ˈkɔːpərət§From uniforms and workwear emerged corporate clothing.§**职业**装是在制服和劳动服的基础上衍生出来的。§
22009§swell§swel§It was the pressure inside the mountain that made it swell.§山体内部的压力使它**膨胀**。§
22010§synthesis§ˈsɪnθəsɪs§You need to make a synthesis of all the ideas I heard in the lecture.§你需要把我在演讲中听到的全部意见**综合**一下。§
22011§excreta§ɪkˈskriːtə§Dung is the droppings or excreta of animals.§Dung就是动物的粪便或**排泄物**。§
22012§decapitate§dɪˈkæpɪteɪt§The fisherman decapitated the fish.§渔民把鱼头给**剁**了。§
22013§pepper§ˈpepə(r)§Only a dash of pepper is enough for the dish.§这道菜只需放一点儿**胡椒粉**就可以了。§
22014§groan§grəʊn§The roof creaked and groaned under the weight of the snow.§屋顶在雪的重压下嘎吱作响，像在**呻吟**。§改译文：原译只译了 creaked，没译 groaned（发出呻吟般的声音），改译
22015§diminish§dɪˈmɪnɪʃ§Our farmland was losing topsoil at a rate likely to diminish the soil's productivity.§我们农田的地表土正在流失，照这样下去，很可能会**降低**土壤的生产力。§
22016§naive§naɪˈiːv§The second flaw in the document is the naive faith it places in its 1,000 core zoos.§这一文献的第二个瑕疵就是，它**天真**地信任了所谓的一千家核心动物园。§
22017§upset§ʌpˈset§The coming final exam upsets the students a lot.§期末考试即将来临，学生们**心烦意乱**。§
22018§appeal§əˈpiːl§You should read things that appeal to you.§你应该阅读一些让你**感兴趣**的东西。§
22019§consumption§kənˈsʌmpʃn§Fuel consumption and exhaust emissions depend on which cars are preferred and how they are driven.§**耗**油量和排气量取决于用户偏爱的车型及其驾驶方式。§
22020§caution§ˈkɔːʃn§You should exercise extreme caution when driving in fog.§在雾中开车要格外**小心**。§
22021§average§ˈævərɪdʒ§How many hours a day on average do you watch TV?§你**平均**每天看几个小时电视？§
22022§blonde§blɒnd§He married a blonde last year.§他去年娶了个**金发女郎**。§
22023§burst§bɜːst§Water pipes often burst in cold weather.§水管在寒冷的天气里经常冻**裂**。§
22024§ecology§iˈkɒlədʒi§If the beetles successfully adapt to their new environment, they'll soon become a part of the local ecology.§如果甲虫完全适应了新的环境，它们很快就会成为当地**生态环境**的一部分。§
22025§profession§prəˈfeʃn§In this highly competitive world, if a man has no profession, there isn't much choice.§在这个竞争非常激烈的世界里，一个人如果没有**专长**就没有多少选择的机会。§
22026§transit§ˈtrænzɪt§They wish to put mass transit systems into and around cities and promote small low emission cars for urban use.§他们希望将**公共交通**系统用于城市和城际交通，而将排气量低的小汽车用于市区交通。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「送）」
22027§medieval§ˌmediˈiːvl§The tourists were shut in the tower of a medieval manor by the kidnappers.§游客被绑架者关在一座**中世纪**庄园的塔楼里。§
22028§behave§bɪˈheɪv§Managers often behave very differently outside the office.§经理在办公室内外的**举止**经常判若两人。§
22029§devastating§ˈdevəsteɪtɪŋ§The devastating earthquake caused great damage to the city.§那场**毁灭性**的地震给这个城市造成了巨大的损失。§
22030§dredge§dredʒ§Those harbours were expensively improved by enlarging, dredging and building breakwaters.§这些港口的情况通过扩建、**疏浚**及建造防浪堤得以改善，但是花销巨大。§
22031§launch§lɔːntʃ§They set about developing a new camera model, which was launched in June 1888.§他们着手研发新的相机款式，并于1888年6月**推出**。§
